use_cases: Displaying welcome messages in multilingual applications with animated text transitions
Creating engaging hero section greetings for landing pages
Adding animated language displays to international marketing campaigns
Enhancing user onboarding experiences with dynamic welcomes
Adding visual interest to dashboard headers with cycling text
ai_summary: An animated greeting component that cycles through multiple language translations (English, Japanese, French, Spanish, Korean, Italian, German) with smooth motion transitions. The text animates vertically using the motion library, appearing and exiting with opacity and position changes. Designed as a standalone, reusable text display component suitable for hero sections, welcome messages, or language-learning interfaces.
